abt.and: Mother's Day is a time when families want to be together
abt.but: hundreds of mothers in Memphis are sitting in jail before trial only because they cannot afford bail as low as $1,000
abt.therefore: Black Lives Matter Memphis is raising $35,000 to pay bail and bring moms home for Mother's Day

m1.core_value: family, and freedom that shouldn't depend on how much money you have
m1.villain: the bail system, which takes people's freedom because they lack money, not because of guilt or innocence
m1.hero: Black Lives Matter Memphis, Shay Jones, and organizer Erica Perry, all named
m1.ask: help raise $35,000 to pay bail for as many women as possible before Mother's Day
m1.summary: Hundreds of Memphis moms are stuck in jail before trial just because they can't afford bail, so Black Lives Matter Memphis is raising money to bring them home for Mother's Day.
